title: ActionSense
about: Kitchen activities recorded with wearable sensors: bimanual 32×32 conductive-thread tactile gloves, finger and body tracking, forearm EMG, eye tracking with a first-person camera, plus 5 static cameras; 20 activities, 10 subjects (tactile for S00–S05).

hardware.d: Palm 23×19, thumb 5×9, little 11×4, other fingers 13×4 · raw ADC counts · ~6 Hz · open fingertips
1280×720 ~30 fps head-mounted · 1600×1200 22 fps static (one above the table)

hardware.v: Xsens MTw Awinda + Manus Prime II gloves
hardware.d: 17 IMUs, body and finger segments at 60 Hz · Myo EMG 8 ch per forearm
Plus calibration periods (scale presses, held objects) and experimenter notes

notes: Paper: NeurIPS 2022 Datasets & Benchmarks (openreview olvz0gAdGOX). Data CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial, credit, same license); code MIT. Each episode is one labelled activity instance cut out of the release's continuous per-split files and re-encoded here. The matrix-to-hand placement of the taxels is derived from the data (non-crossing matrix entries barely respond), not from a published map; see each episode's notes. Up to six right-glove crossings toggle between rest and ~1018 (an intermittent read-out fault, not contact); they are flagged per episode from the data, drawn hollow and left out of the plots and sums.
